named-native-query.name: CheckHTHPendingApproval
named-native-query.query: SELECT 1 FROM HTH_BEA.HTH_MANAGEMENT_REQUEST R JOIN DIGX_AP_TRANSACTION T ON T.TXN_ID = R.TRANSACTION_ID WHERE R.PARTY_ID = #partyId AND R.OBJECT_STATUS = 'A' AND T.APPR_STATUS IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL', 'MODIFICATION_REQUESTED')
